mapper.select: SELECT call_type, count(*) AS calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT success) AS failures, avg(latency_ms) AS latency_ms, CASE WHEN count(input_tokens) = count(*) THEN sum(input_tokens) END AS input_tokens, CASE WHEN count(output_tokens) = count(*) THEN sum(output_tokens) END AS output_tokens, CASE WHEN count(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL AND NOT billed_externally) = 0 THEN coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) END AS cost_usd, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL AND NOT billed_externally) AS unpriced_calls, count(*) FILTER (WHERE billed_externally) AS externally_billed_calls FROM llm_usage WHERE occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{until} AND call_type = #{callType} GROUP BY call_type ORDER BY call_type

SELECT coalesce(sum(cost_usd), 0) AS priced_usd, count(*) FILTER (WHERE cost_usd IS NULL AND NOT billed_externally) AS unpriced_calls FROM llm_usage WHERE occurred_at >= #{from} AND occurred_at < #{until}
